comment: Performance budgets enforced by scripts/perf-baseline.mjs against the local test build (mobile, simulated throttling, third-party vendors blocked). Enforcement = per-metric median of the route's Lighthouse runs (same statistic the summary prints). LCP error recalibrated 2026-09-24 in #163: measured homepage medians ran 4.4-4.7s across 10+ CI/local runs (Sentry #157 added ~54KB JS ≈ +0.4s; rest is site drift), so 4500 sat inside normal variance and failed ~half of runs. 5000 = ~6% headroom over the worst observed median (4715) — still trips on a meaningful breach; warn 3600 keeps the original target visible. Error = must not regress meaningfully; warn = investigate. Tighten deliberately; never loosen to silence a real regression.
